messages:
maya: Concordia Health dedicated rollout requested for 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC. Requesting final go/no-go. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rollouts/conv/12345 · release ticket #CON-987

deploy-bot: rollout created · concordia-dedicated · requested-by maya · scheduled: 2026-04-03T02:00Z · version: v1.4.3-rc2 
Checks: infra_ok ✅, capacity_ok ✅, canary_config_present ✅, release_notes_missing ⚠️

alex: heads-up — saw a kv-cache regression in rc2 on perf tests (mem spike). Can we pin to v1.4.3+hf1 (sha: abc123) instead of rc2?

maya: good catch. yes please pin to v1.4.3+hf1. @ryan can you update observability for the concordia canary slice (concordia-canary-1)?

ryan: on it. will add p95, error_rate, tokens/s. will also create anomaly alerts. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/d/conv-concordia

samir: proposed canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 20m steady windows. rollback if error_rate +1.2% absolute or p95 > 700ms. thoughts?

lia: prefer slightly larger first slice for statistical signal — 10% initial (15m) -> 30% (20m) -> 100% (30m). also require health endpoint success >= 99.5% before each step.

maya: agree to lia's plan. summarize updated plan:
- pin version: v1.4.3+hf1
- canary slices: 10% (15m) -> 30% (20m) -> 100% (30m)
- rollback triggers: error_rate increase > 1.0% absolute OR p95 > 800ms OR 5xx > 0.5%
- observability: ryan to add dashboards and paging thresholds
- docs: release notes + data-handling attested on ticket #CON-987

deploy-bot: Canary policy updated for rollout roll-1717609999. To start rollout run:
/deploy start concordia --version=v1.4.3+hf1 --canary=10,30,100 --steps=15,20,30

opsbot: infra checks:
- k8s nodes: 24/24 healthy
- GPUs reserved: 4 (nvidia-a100)
- network egress rules validated
- capacity margin: 18%
-> all PASS

maya: confirm release notes and PI/PHI handling are attached to ticket before we hit the window. who will own monitoring for the first 60m?

samir: I'll own monitoring first 30m, alex takes second 30m. escalation to oncall if alert fires. Release notes uploaded to #CON-987, data handling: no PHI logged, retention config validated.

alex: infra +1. will watch capacity and autoscaler behavior. quick snippet of canary config we used for testing:
```
canary_policy: {
  steps: [10,30,100],
  windows_mins: [15,20,30],
  health_check: "/-/healthz",
  success_threshold: 0.995
}
```

ryan: dashboards updated. added anomaly alert rules: error_rate_abs > 0.8% -> page-on-call, p95 >700ms -> warn in #eng-releases. Slack alert hook tested.

maya: final schedule: 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC. everyone ok with that window?

alex: +1

lia: approved

samir: ok from my side

ryan: good to go

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: id=roll-1717609999 · target=concordia-dedicated · version=v1.4.3+hf1 · window=2026-04-03T02:00Z
Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/roll-1717609999
If rollback required: /deploy rollback roll-1717609999 --to=previous

maya: thanks all — will trigger per runbook. leaving this thread open for any late blockers. :thumbsup:
